events.title: European Shares Likely To Open On Firm Note Ahead Of Anthropic Debut
events.description: European stocks may open on a firm note on Thursday after Anthropic's IPO raised $81.31 billion, surpassing SpaceX's reported $75 billion offering and pushing the company's valuation beyond its earlier target of $1.4 trillion.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher; Auto Stocks Surge As IT Stocks Drag
events.description: Indian shares were little changed on Thursday after falling notably in the previous session due to profit taking after recent string of gains.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is maintaining its early losses in mid-market moves on Thursday, extending the losses in the previous five sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 8,750 level, with weakness in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower
events.description: Asian markets are trading mostly lower on Thursday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, with weakness in mining and energy stocks amid tumbling commodity prices. Expectation of more aggressive monetary tightening by the US Fed on interest rates is weighing on market sentiment. Asian markets closed mixed on Wednesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Set To Extend Losses In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening lower on Thursday after key benchmark indexes snapped a two-day rally in the previous session.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Halt Its Slide On Thursday
events.description: The Thai stock market has tracked lower in three straight sessions, shedding almost 35 points or 2.2 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,470-point plateau although it may find support on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Modestly Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is trading modestly higher on Thursday, extending the gains in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving above the 59,100 level, with gains in index heavyweights and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in financial stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market Likely Rangebound On Thursday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Wednesday ended the two-day winning streak in which it had fallen almost 40 points or 0.8 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 5,250-point plateau although it's looking at a steady start on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Lower
events.description: The Australian market is trading notably lower on Thursday, extending the losses in the previous five sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling well below the 8,800 level, with weakness in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, sliding more than 450 points or 2 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just beneath the 23,300-point plateau although it's expected to open to the upside on Thursday.

events.title: China Stock Market May Test Resistance At 3,600 Points
events.description: The China stock market on Wednesday snapped the four-day losing streak in which it had slumped almost 100 points or 2.7 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,590-point plateau and it may see additional support on Thursday.

events.title: Australia Jobless Rate Jumps To 4.9% In October
events.description: The unemployment rate in Australia came in at a seasonally adjusted 4.9 percent in October, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May Add To Its Winnings
events.description: The Taiwan stock market on Wednesday ended the two-day losing streak in which it had tumbled almost 3,600 points or 8.6 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just beneath the 40,200-point plateau and it may pick up steam on Thursday.
